name: nextcollege-masterclass-scaffold
description: Scaffold profesional y Template Repository para webinars y masterclasses: E-commerce (Astro), PWA (React), Admin Dashboard (React), Node.js API y MySQL con CI/CD automatizado en Dokploy.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/ecommerce && npm install --prefix apps/pwa && npm install --prefix apps/admin && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build:all: npm run build:ecommerce && npm run build:pwa && npm run build:admin && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('server/public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/ecommerce/dist', 'server/public/ecommerce', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/pwa/dist', 'server/public/pwa', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/admin/dist', 'server/public/admin', {recursive:true}); console.log('✅ Artefactos sincronizados en server/public');"

author: Pablo Valdivia
